items.title: Vijaye Raji to become CTO of Applications with acquisition of Statsig
items.summary: Vijaye Raji will step into a new role as CTO of Applications, reporting to CEO of Applications, Fidji Simo, following the acquisition of Statsig.

items.title: Building more helpful ChatGPT experiences for everyone
items.summary: We’re partnering with experts, strengthening protections for teens with parental controls, and routing sensitive conversations to reasoning models in ChatGPT.

items.title: Make your ZeroGPU Spaces go brrr with ahead-of-time compilation
items.summary: 来自原始信息源的最新动态，点击标题查看完整内容。
items.summaryZh: Hugging Face推出针对ZeroGPU Spaces的Ahead-of-Time（AoT）编译技术支持。通过提前编译模型，替代运行时的动态编译，能够有效解决ZeroGPU短生命周期进程的痛点。该技术可在Flux、Wan和LTX等模型上实现1.3倍至1.8倍的性能提升，并结合FP8量化与动态形状等高级技巧，大幅优化多媒体生成演示的运行流畅度与硬件利用率。

aiReview.reasonZh: 文章介绍了Hugging Face Spaces上利用Ahead-of-Time编译技术优化ZeroGPU运行性能的方法。
